entries.title: Psalms 118:1
segments: O give thanks to the LORD; for [He is] good; because His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:2
segments: Let Israel now say that His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:3
segments: Let the house of Aaron now say that His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:4
segments: Let those who fear the LORD now say that His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:5
segments: I called on the LORD in distress; the LORD answered me, and [set me] in a large place.

entries.title: Psalms 118:6
segments: The LORD [is] for me, I will not fear; what can man do to me?

entries.title: Psalms 118:7
segments: The LORD [is] for me among those who help me; and I will see [my desire] on those who hate me.

entries.title: Psalms 118:8
segments: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to trust in man.

entries.title: Psalms 118:9
segments: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to trust in princes.

entries.title: Psalms 118:10
segments: All the nations surround me, but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

entries.title: Psalms 118:11
segments: They surround me; yea, they surround me, but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

entries.title: Psalms 118:12
segments: They surround me like bees; they are put out like the fire of thorns; for in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

entries.title: Psalms 118:13
segments: You have thrust hard at me so that I might fall; but the LORD helped me.

entries.title: Psalms 118:14
segments: The LORD [is] my strength and song, and He is my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:15
segments: The voice of rejoicing and salvation [is] in the tents of the righteous; the right hand of the LORD does mighty things.

entries.title: Psalms 118:16
segments: The right hand of the LORD is lifted up; the right hand of the LORD does mighty things.

entries.title: Psalms 118:17
segments: I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 118:18
segments: The LORD has sorely chastened me; but He has not given me over to death.

entries.title: Psalms 118:19
segments: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will go into them, [and] I will praise the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 118:20
segments: This [is] the gate of the LORD into which the righteous shall enter.

entries.title: Psalms 118:21
segments: I will praise You; for You have heard me, and are my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:22
segments: The Stone [which] the builders refused has become the Head of the corner.

entries.title: Psalms 118:23
segments: This is from the LORD; it [is] marvelous in our eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 118:24
segments: This [is] the day [which] the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

entries.title: Psalms 118:25
segments: Save now, I beseech You, O LORD; O LORD, I beseech You, cause [us] to prosper now.

entries.title: Psalms 118:26
segments: Blessed [is] He coming in the name of the LORD; we have blessed You out of the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 118:27
segments: God [is] the LORD, who gives light to us. Tie the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.

entries.title: Psalms 118:28
segments: You [are] my God, and I will exalt You; You [are] my God, I will praise You.

entries.title: Psalms 118:29
segments: Oh give thanks to the LORD; for [He is] good; for His mercy [endures] forever.
